# `Q-20-9` — Remote Image Could Not Be Fetched for Typst in the Browser

> A remote image could not be downloaded while producing Typst in the
> browser, so its alt text is used instead.

## What this means

pandoc.wasm has no network access, so the browser downloads each
`https://` image itself before pandoc runs. When a download fails (the
server is unreachable, the response is over the size limit or is not an
image, the URL is `http://`, or the server does not allow a web page to
read it with CORS), Typst would stop on the missing image, so the image
is replaced by its alt text and this warning names the URL and the
reason. Native `q2 render` is not affected.

## How to fix

Download the image into the project and reference it by path.
